prs.author: stakeswky
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Plain JSON Schema objects passed as inputSchema to server.tool() are not handled correctly — both PRs address this same root cause in src/server/mcp.ts but with opposing strategies: #1596 rejects such objects with a runtime error (argument-parsing path, ~line 1024), while #1617 detects and preserves them transparently (serialization path, ~line 146, plus type widening at ~line 1000). prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Plain JSON Schema objects passed as inputSchema to server.tool() are not handled correctly — both PRs address this same root cause in src/server/mcp.ts but with opposing strategies: #1596 rejects such objects with a runtime error (argument-parsing path, ~line 1024), while #1617 detects and preserves them transparently (serialization path, ~line 146, plus type widening at ~line 1000). prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1617 is backwards-compatible (existing callers passing plain JSON Schema keep working) and is more complete (widens the inputSchema type AND adds a serialization bypass). #1596's rejection heuristic — throwing when any value in the object is itself an object — is a breaking change and risks false positives if ToolAnnotations ever gains an object-typed field.
